summary: Resolve twenty-one of twenty-two exact lifecycle chains as positively post-Velious; source-only disable twenty-four exclusive helpers/controllers and guard one later trial entry in a mixed classic monk controller. Preserve all classic branches and original disabled bodies. Krup watcher, Kesler grant mapping and Xantis live recharge success remain explicitly bounded.

evidence.note: Official expansion retrospective identifies mounts and Beastlord as additions introduced by Shadows of Luclin. Used only for era, not gameplay values.

June 13, 2003 contemporary discussion quotes EQLive describing changes made to Befallen with the tabletop module and explicitly directs players to Sir Ariam for a horse. Respondents identify the one-charge bridle and no-rent intermediate. The original EQLive article is quoted by a contemporary poster, not independently fetched; precise introduction day is not established.

First-person walkthrough gives skeleton kills, Skeletal Foreman death, Sir Ariam appearance, Ghostly Bridle and Scroll of the Burning Dead, then Sir Artanis turn-in. This matches the exact local chain, not the older Opal/Marnek mystery.
Official March 9, 2016 test patch says historical review moved the Temple-to-Accursed Temple transition from Velious to Luclin.

October 2002 guild account identifies Ring of Fear as added with the Accursed Temple transition: rotating Avatar of Fear, repeated waves, then Dread, Fright and Terror followed by Fear. It recalls an April 2002 attempt. This distinguishes the later ring from the original static Avatar.

Ring of Fear walkthrough starts with a Thul Tae Ew High Priest, then Avatar of Fear and add waves, with Tahia Felwah nearby. Used for exact actor-chain identity only; modern timing and combat values are not imported.

The four Tae Ew Justicar positions around the pyramid match local High Priest spawn coordinates exactly; their spawn rows and Tahia Felwah are marked Luclin. Used only with official era and independent encounter evidence, not as standalone metadata proof.

Contemporaneous September 2004 Epic 1.5 investigation contains the goblin-disguise contest, goblin-language start phrase, whipcracker shout and King Dronan/Garzul identities. Local spell5574 gate and exact three spawns belong to that contest. Direct page fetch returned403. Search-index excerpt only; no fresh full-page claim.

Contemporaneous Epic 1.5 investigation identifies Kithicor Blackened Treant, multiple branches on death, then Blackened Dryad after the last branch. Later reward is Blackened Earth for Staff of Living Brambles. Direct page fetch returned403. Branch count and combat values are not being matched.
Druid epic checklist explicitly lists haunt, spirit, guardian tormentor and lamented knight in sequence leading to Soul Stone, then the later Mangled Head and Plane of Justice steps.
Druid 1.5 guide identifies the madman forcing each spirit out, with each kill spawning the next and the lamented knight last. Used with contemporary checklist and exact local spawn/signal chain.

Berserker epic guide matches Lingering Axefall/Impervious Bloodbeast and, separately, Raving Goblinmaster with frantic and Ferocious goblin waves. Local Axefall source explicitly checks Berserker and creates85225; assigned helper signals85091.

Official Gates of Discord announcement introduces Berserker, positively bounding its exclusive epic support outside Velious. Public evidence already verified in changes/p99-support-source-review/lifecycle-review-public-evidence.json; not newly fetched here.

October 2006 community discussion explicitly identifies Yuanda, werewolves, Shady Bandit, Gnoll Scavenger and Worboli/shark as the alternate 1.5 prequest. Exact local Yuanda and Worboli source headers independently label Necromancer1.5 prequest.

Beastlord1.5 player checklist gives Rambling and Raving Sphinx Spiritservants, Zazamoukh/Ankhefenmut, Tarnished/Sullied Ankh Pieces and Gift of the Sphinx, matching the exact local beast_epic12/13 controller chain.
Beastlord walkthrough identifies Scout Sihmoj, Timorous Deep Draz Nurakk, six images each dropping a glass shard and return to Elder Dumul. Distinct from the later Fungus Grove same-name target.

P99 item page explicitly labels Shackle of Tynnonium post-Velious and non-P99. This is positive scope evidence, not absence of a walkthrough. Live wiki is not claimed; search index last crawled within a week.

P99 discussion reproduces the Tynnonium Trial of Patience sequence: Iksar master becomes Grand Master Rinmark, then Master Rinmark, then Rinmark, whose kill provides Mark of Patience. Exact emotes match the local helper bodies. Direct page fetch timed out. The quoted walkthrough establishes identity, not P99 implementation. Tynnonium item page supplies exclusion.

May 2011 P99 resolved-issues thread documents Xantis recharge attempt with ring and one platinum/ten gold; response rejected the player for faction and other players specify warmly. Later multipart attempts also failed. It corroborates the recharge NPC and offered price, but does not independently prove a successful recharge or denomination acceptance.
Preserved P99 NPC page says Kesler gives books, but supplies neither topic-to-item IDs nor quantities. Current P99 Paineel search index corroborates the same brief statement.

-- Converted from ProjectEQ Perl quest script.
-- Source: qey2hh1/12184.pl

function event_spawn(e)
	eq.set_timer("Werewolf2Depop", 1800000)
	eq.set_next_hp_event(75)
end

function event_death_complete(e)
	e.self:Say("Your attack was in vain, fool. The staff was stolen from us by a bandit only hours ago.")
	eq.spawn2(12185, 186, 0, -11080, -2920, 38, 0) -- Shady Bandit
end

function event_timer(e)
	eq.stop_timer("Werewolf2Depop")
	eq.depop()
end

function event_combat(e)
	if e.joined then
		e.self:Emote("moves to attack.")
	else
		e.self:MoveTo(e.self:GetX(), e.self:GetY(), e.self:GetZ(), e.self:GetHeading(), true)
	end
end

function event_hp(e)
	if e.hp_event == 75 then
		e.self:ModifyNPCStat("max_hit", "1400")
		eq.set_next_hp_event(50)
	elseif e.hp_event == 50 then
		e.self:ModifyNPCStat("max_hit", "1600")
		eq.set_next_hp_event(25)
	elseif e.hp_event == 25 then
		e.self:ModifyNPCStat("max_hit", "1800")
	end
end

before.lua_content:
function event_say(e)
local zone_time = eq.get_zone_time();

 if(e.language == 14 and e.other:GetLanguageSkill(14) >= 100 and zone_time["zone_hour"]==19 and e.other:FindBuff(5574)) then
	if (e.message:findi("start the contest")) then
		e.self:Shout("You right! Me want prize! Start contest! King Dronan owe us contest!");
		eq.unique_spawn(92198, 0, 0, 2436, 3546, 320, 188);  --Goblin King Dronan
		eq.unique_spawn(92199, 0, 0, 2404, 3541, 322, 206); --Whip Cracker Garzul
		eq.unique_spawn(92200, 0, 0, 2470, 3551, 313, 176);  --Earth Seer Hunknort
	end	
 end
 
 if (e.message:findi("testquestfile")) then
	e.self:Say("lang:" .. e.language)
	e.self:Say("skill:" .. e.other:GetLanguageSkill(14))
	e.self:Say("zh: " .. zone_time["zone_hour"]);
	if (e.other:FindBuff(5574)) then
		e.self:Say("hasbuff")
	end
 end
end

before.name: an_Iksar_master
before.lua_content:
-- Converted from ProjectEQ Perl quest script.
-- Source: timorous/an_Iksar_master.pl
-- items: 17036, 17039, 17040, 12815, 12797, 12829, 12836, 4195

local function monk_faction(e)
	e.other:Faction(444, 20, 0)
	e.other:Faction(441, 10, 0)
end

function event_say(e)
	if e.message:findi("hail") then
		e.self:Emote("is humming and chanting softly. He seems oblivious to your presence.")
	elseif e.message:findi("master rinmark") then
		e.self:Emote("squints one eye open, then returns to his meditation.")
	elseif e.message:findi("talon southpaw") then
		e.self:Emote("waves his arms in the air. 'The great master. His soul is the wind. He speaks to us in words of thunder. He strikes Norrath with bolts of lightning. I seek to be as he is. I have traveled the globe in search of his fists. I have found only one. Another is said to be with [Gomoz]. I shall return it when I am finished with my seasons-long meditation or perhaps I shall find a monk to [return the hand to Cabilis].'")
	elseif e.message:findi("Gomoz") then
		e.self:Say("Disciple Gomoz was once Talon Southpaw's pupil. It is rumored that he has only one hand. Unfortunately, a horde of ogre raiders swiped his bones, along with others, from their place in Kurn's Tower. What those simple oafs plan to do with them is a mystery. Only one who has studied the arcane sciences could use them. They most likely used them as soup bones.")
	elseif e.message:findi("return the hand to Cabilis") then
		e.self:Emote("hands you an old tattered sack. 'This shall be your proof of allegiance. Prove that you are strong with an intact mandible of a skulking brutling and the claws of a burynai excavator. Prove that you are a monk of fist and tail with a sash of an exiled human monk and the sparring gloves of a goblin pit fighter. Combined, these items make the sack full. This will earn my trust and the hand.'")
		e.other:SummonItem(17036)
	elseif e.message:findi("assist old Rinmark in completing his rock garden") then
		e.self:Emote("pours the pebbles into his pocket and hands the box to you. 'Take my box. Fill and combine within my box the following; a radiant meteorite, frontier fool's gold, petrified redwood, Rile's sand coin, sulfur stone, fragment of tektite, plains pebble, jade magma, heart of ice and an unholy coldstone. Return the full tin box to me and I shall reward you with a shackle of bronze.'")
		e.other:SummonItem(17039)
	elseif e.message:findi("student") then
		e.self:Emote("hands you what appears to be the base of a key. 'This was delivered to me by a dying student. He collapsed just after handing it to me. He was accompanying a student of mine named Veltar. They were questing for the legendary Whistling Fists. The key is made of a metal I have never felt or heard of. Find him.'")
		e.other:SummonItem(17040)
	elseif e.message:findi("test of patience") then
		e.self:Say("So your time has finally come to be tested for the final rung. To show your patience you shall spar with me. When you have gained the insight and strategy to strike you will know when. Strike me too soon and you will perish, too late and I will be gone. Come at me when the time is right. Let us begin.")
		eq.spawn2(96318, 0, 0, e.self:GetX(), e.self:GetY(), e.self:GetZ(), e.self:GetHeading())
		eq.depop_with_timer()
	elseif e.message:findi("whistling fists") then
		e.self:Say("The Whistling Fists are rumored to be magical instruments of destruction which can only be wielded by monks. The founder, Supreme Master Tynn, was the only lizard to ever gaze upon the weapon. He only spoke of it to his student Marthor. Marthor rarely spoke of it and when he did it was usually after a few flagons of Trog Brew. That is why many consider it to be babble.")
	end
end

function event_trade(e)
	local item_lib = require("items")
	if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 12815}) then
		e.self:Emote("bows before you and takes a wrinkled, mummified hand from a pouch at his side. 'Take the hand. Let it rest within Cabilis and be reunited with the left.'")
		e.other:SummonItem(12797)
		e.other:AddEXP(20000)
		e.other:Ding()
		monk_faction(e)
	elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 12829}) then
		e.self:Emote("opens the box to reveal a variety of pebbles. 'How grand!! My pebbles!! Now I can continue with my rock garden!! Hmmm. You look familiar. Hey!! I bet you can help me complete my garden!! Would you please [assist old Rinmark in completing his rock garden]?'")
		e.other:AddEXP(30000)
		e.other:Ding()
		monk_faction(e)
	elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 12836}) then
		e.self:Emote("graciously accepts the tin box filled with precious rocks and gems. 'Thank you greatly, young " .. e.other:GetName() .. ". For your deed, I bestow upon you the shackle of bronze!! You have completed the third rung. Alas, there is no time for celebration. I need your help in rescuing a [student] of mine.'")
		e.other:SummonItem(4195)
		e.other:AddEXP(30000)
		e.other:Ding()
		monk_faction(e)
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
